ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, a black dot is located near the right edge of the circular track; starting from the black dot there are multiple candidate arrows: B points horizontally left toward the direction of the center of the circle, D points upward, E points right, A points diagonally down-left, and C points diagonally up-left. The problem states that the object undergoes uniform circular motion. In uniform circular motion, the net force provides the centripetal force, and its direction always points along the radius toward the center of the circle. At this moment the object is on the right side of the circle, so the direction pointing toward the center of the circle is horizontally left, corresponding to arrow B.

raw_record.question_text: In the accompanying figure, what is the direction of the net force acting on the object moving in uniform circular motion at the instant shown?

method.method_draft: Identify from the image that the black dot is located on the right side of a circular path, and that arrow B points horizontally left from the dot toward the circle’s center. Read from the text that the motion is uniform circular motion and the question asks for the net force direction. Use the rule that in uniform circular motion the net force is centripetal, always directed radially inward toward the center of the circle. Since inward from the rightmost point is leftward, select B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中，一个黑点位于圆形轨道的右侧边缘附近；从黑点出发有多个候选箭头：B 水平向左指向圆心方向，D 向上，E 向右，A 斜向左下，C 斜向左上。题目说明物体做匀速圆周运动。匀速圆周运动中，合力提供向心力，方向总是沿半径指向圆心。此刻物体在圆的右侧，所以指向圆心的方向是水平向左，对应箭头 B。

method.method_draft: Use the curved arrow in the image to determine the object’s motion around the circle, then imagine the velocity direction just before and just after the shown right-side position: the velocity is tangent to the path, and its direction changes as the object moves through that point. The change in velocity, hence the acceleration, points inward toward the center of curvature. From the dot on the right side, inward is to the left, corresponding to arrow B. Read the text only to confirm the situation is uniform circular motion and that the requested quantity is net force, not velocity.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个圆形轨道，物体以黑点标在圆的右侧边缘。圆内左上方有一条弯曲箭头，箭头沿圆周方向指示运动方向。在黑点处画出五个候选方向箭头：A 指向左下，B 指向左，C 指向左上，D 指向上，E 指向右。

推理：题目说明物体做匀速圆周运动，所求是瞬时净力方向。匀速圆周运动中速度方向沿切线，但净力提供向心加速度，方向始终指向圆心。黑点位于圆的最右侧，因此从黑点指向圆心的方向是向左。图中向左的箭头标为 B。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: By Newton’s second law, net force points in the direction of acceleration; in circular motion the acceleration is the direction of the velocity change, which is inward toward the center.
